sections.title: Minimally Invasive Steering of Language Models
sections.abstract: The paper proposes MISVO, a Fisher/KL-geometry regularized method for steering frozen language models at test time while limiting distributional damage.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors introduce MISVO and derive an analytic Fisher-based surrogate for position-specific steering without updating model parameters.
sections.caveat: The evidence is from a preprint and seven model–task settings; broader independent replication is needed.

sections.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
sections.abstract: PoEM predicts the policy produced by reinforcement learning on a new reward by combining models already trained on other rewards, avoiding another RL run.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors show that reward-conditioned log-policies can often occupy an approximately low-rank subspace and use this to approximate a target RL policy without additional RL training.
sections.caveat: The low-rank relationship is empirical outside the linear-reward case; generalization remains open.

sections.title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
sections.abstract: Controlled visual-stream corruption shows that common scalar visual–text alignment measures can remain high even when MLLM task accuracy collapses, motivating a principal-angle-gap diagnostic.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors identify weight-induced alignment as a source of misleading similarity scores and propose the principal-angle gap.
sections.caveat: The diagnostic is evaluated on the tested architectures, corruption settings, and tasks.

sections.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
sections.abstract: VeriSpeak benchmarks spoken-claim verification and finds a text–speech modality gap, with explicit reasoning over retrieved evidence outperforming retrieval alone.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors introduce VeriSpeak and show that grounded claim–evidence comparison is needed for speech misinformation detection.
sections.caveat: The benchmark and result depend on the selected spoken-claim distribution and model setup.

sections.title: Temporal Gradient Inversion for Private Trajectory Reconstruction in Embodied Reinforcement Learning
sections.abstract: TRACE reconstructs private embodied-RL observation–action trajectories from consecutive policy gradients by exploiting temporal correlation and policy-head structure.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors introduce TRACE, formalize a temporal leakage signal, and derive an exact action-recovery condition under sufficiently small entropy regularization.
sections.caveat: The attack results are preprint claims evaluated on held-out embodied scenes.

sections.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
sections.abstract: An agentic, context-aware workflow uses adaptive social queries to infer the intent behind conspiracy-related Hebrew social-media posts.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors frame conspiracy detection as socially embedded interpretation and supply tools for per-case evidence gathering.
sections.caveat: The dataset is Hebrew and the evaluation is tied to its manually annotated adversarial set.
